# awscc_appfabric_app_authorization (Resource)

Creates an app authorization within an app bundle, which allows AppFabric to connect to an application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) The name of the application.
- `app_bundle_identifier` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) or Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) of the app bundle to use for the request.
- `auth_type` (String) The authorization type.
- `tenant` (Attributes) Contains information about an application tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))

### Optional

- `credential` (Attributes) Contains credentials for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to apply to the app authorization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `app_authorization_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app authorization.
- `app_authorization_identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the app authorization.
- `app_bundle_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app bundle for the app authorization.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp of when the app authorization was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `persona` (String) The user persona of the app authorization.
- `status` (String) The state of the app authorization.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp of when the app authorization was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_app_authorization.example
  identity = {
    app_authorization_arn = "app_authorization_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_authorization_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app authorization

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_app_authorization.example
  id = "app_authorization_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_appfabric_app_authorization.example "app_authorization_arn"
```
